en:
Honestly! You're so mean,
Captain. If you've discovered
ruins that look like they're
hiding such treasures, you
should tell me sooner!
When it comes to ruins, I'm the\nexpert! Now, let's get this\nexploration moving!
...Captain. I'm sorry. This is late,\nbut... could I be excused from\nthis exploration?

(If the things from when I was
controlled by the Crimson
Shield are revealed... no, more
than that, the Ancient
Covenant...)
Oh my, what's wrong? Are you\nafraid of the dark, Mavelle?
Ah, no, it's not that...
...My past is, well...
It can't be helped then.
I don't care what your past is.
Let's agree not to look into\neach other's pasts.
Thank you. In that case, I'll\nhead back to the ship.

Mavelle, it's dangerous to go
back alone. If you don't mind, I
can escort you back to the
ship...
Oh, but we can't have your\npast being projected while\nwe're on the way...
Sarah, I can manage on my\nown...
I've got it! I'll blindfold you and\nput in some earplugs, then\nescort you back!
Wait, wouldn't that make things\nmore dangerous for you,\nSarah?
With a Featherfolk's sixth\nsense, I can handle something\nlike this...
Ah! Sarah, there's a wall that\nway!!
Wait, if a vision of the past\nappears, we all just close our\neyes and cover our ears?

That's a wonderful idea,
Captain. I heard from Meri and
the others that there's a
warning sign before the past is
projected.

When that sign appears,
everyone except the person
whose past is being shown will
close their eyes and cover
their ears.
Once we confirm the person is\nokay, we'll have everyone else\nopen their eyes.
This way, Mavelle can join us in\nexploring these ruins!
All this for my sake... I'm sorry,\nCaptain, Sarah.
I appreciate you saying that,\nbut...

Now, now, Captain. No matter
how much you trust each
other, everyone has a past
they'd rather keep secret.

For example, I wouldn't want
anyone to know about the time
I mistook the front door for the
bath and caused a huge scene
in my village!
...Isn't it a bit late for that,\nconsidering you just told us\nyourself?

Ah, you're right! I completely
forgot. Please keep that a
secret from the others who
aren't here!
So, how about we all agree not\nto peek when someone's past\nis being shown?
Meri and the others told me\nthere's a sign right before a\npast is revealed.

When that sign appears,
everyone except the person
whose past is being shown
should close their eyes and
cover their ears.

Once the person involved
confirms everything is okay,
then everyone else can open
their eyes.
That way, Mavelle can explore\nthese ruins with us too!
Thank you, Sarah.

It's a great plan! Meri and the
others mentioned there's a
sign before the past is
revealed.

Once that omen appears,
everyone except the person
seeing the past must close
their eyes and cover their ears.

I'll check on the person seeing
the past first, and if everything
looks okay, I'll tell everyone
else to open their eyes.
Captain, Sarah... thank you for\nyour kindness.
Now, I'll go tell Celine to keep\nher eyes closed too.
This is the omen! Captain,\nplease close your eyes and\ncover your ears!
Hmm, being a Featherfolk\nseems like hard work.
Ehehehe.
Everyone seems to be okay.\nYou can open your eyes now.
The gap between the omen\nand the vision is so short, it\nmakes me panic.
Was this something that\nhappened on Edge's\nspaceship?
Oh, you're back, Celine. It looks\nlike it was.
What's so difficult about it?
I'm talking about Sarah's\npeople... the Featherfolk.

Apparently, they practice
pure-bloodism to protect the
"Holy Wings," meaning they can
only marry within their own
race.
Some minority groups on Earth\nused to be like that too. I\nguess it's the same on Roak.
What?! Sarah, you can only\nmarry someone from your\nvillage?!
That's right. That's just how\nthe rules are.

Rules?! Are you really okay
with that? You'll have to spend
the rest of your life with
someone your parents or the
village chose for you!

Yes. Everyone in the village is
so kind, so I'm sure I'll be
happy no matter who my
spouse is.
No matter who... Sarah...\nthat's just absurd!

The Featherfolk are a very
rare race on Roak, so I believe
it's a rule meant to preserve
the species.
They're sacrificing Sarah's\nentire life just to preserve the\nspecies?!
Sarah, listen to me! Think\nabout this! Are you truly okay\nwith this?!

I would absolutely hate it if my
parents chose my spouse for
me. I want to find someone
with my own eyes... someone I
can truly feel is the one for
me.
Miss Celine...
Miss Celine, I don't believe\nSarah is sacrificing herself.

What...? But she said she'd
marry anyone as long as it's
for the sake of protecting her
race!
Yes, anyone as long as they\nare a member of the\nFeatherfolk village.

In other words, she will live
alongside the villagers,
cherishing the bloodline that
the clan has protected in
accordance with the wishes of
those who built the Featherfolk
village.
I believe that is the way of life\nSarah has chosen out of love\nfor her clan.

I suppose you're right. It was
presumptuous of me to decide
that Sarah was being
sacrificed for her clan.

I'm sorry, Sarah. You have your
own way of living. I think I tried
to force my own views upon
you.
Not at all. You were only\nconcerned for my happiness,\nMiss Celine. Thank you.

Besides, Miss Celine, there's no
need to worry. Everyone in the
Featherfolk village lives by
helping one another.

Whether they are married or
not, everyone in the village is
like one big family from the
very start.

Mavelle is right. It's so relaxed
that you could accidentally fall
asleep in your neighbor's
bedroom and they wouldn't
even notice!
I suspect that might be a habit\nunique to you, Sarah...
Still, Mavelle, you sure seem to\nknow a lot about the\nFeatherfolk village!
Indeed. From what I've heard, it\nsounds like a very secluded\nplace...
Eh, u-um... I heard it from\nIoshua! He told me about his\nhometown during our travels!!
Oh, I see. You two really are\nclose, aren't you? Erys might\nget jealous.
(Phew... I'm glad I managed to\nplay it off...)
Ugh...!
Wawa! It's a sign! Celine, close\nyour eyes!
What!?
If it's not too much trouble,\nmay I join you?
...Yes.
Thank you, Sarah. It seems my\nworries were unfounded.
I'm glad it worked out!

Glad is not the word for it!
What on earth possessed you
to suddenly run into someone
while your eyes were closed!
You almost knocked me over!
Sorry... it just happened so\nsuddenly...
You said there was a reason\nfor this... I expect a full\nexplanation later!
Now then, Mavelle. Am I\ncorrect in assuming this is a\nglimpse into your past?
Yes. These are memories from\nafter my journey with Lati and\nthe others.
Recently, a thought occurred\nto me.
Please, don't laugh. But\nsomehow, I see traces of my\nsister in you...
What is it? Why are you\ncrying...?
Oh, I-I'm sorry...
And so, the two of them\ncontinued their journey\ntogether.
Yes.
(I'll seek atonement on this\njourney, so that one day I can\ntell my brother everything...)

I've heard that this ruin often
replays memories that are
relevant to the current
situation.
For Ioshua's memories to\nsurface while we were talking\nabout marriage... could it be?
What?! Please don't jump to\nthe wrong conclusion!!

We were talking about the
Featherfolk village, and that's
why I remembered things about
Ioshua.

But to go so far as to offer to
accompany you on a journey to
find your sister... I can't help
but be suspicious!

N-no, that's not it! I know how
it feels to search for someone
precious to you, so that's why I
agreed to let him come along!

Hehe, the way you're
desperately trying to cover it
up only makes you look more
suspicious. Sarah, what do you
think?
Hmm. I can see where Celine is\ncoming from.
Hehe, exactly!
Not Sarah too...

I think I understand how Celine
feels―that you want to marry
the person you've decided on
for yourself.
What?! Why bring that up\nnow?!
I never would have thought\nabout such things before.

But after meeting Edge and
the others, I've learned about
all the excitement that exists
not just outside the village, but
beyond the skies...

That's why I want everyone in
the village to be free to go out
into the world and find their
own excitement.
Sarah...
Of course, it's also important\nto protect the things the\nvillage holds dear...
So you mean embracing new\nperspectives while still\nrespecting tradition.
Exactly.
It won't be an easy path, but I\nfeel like you can do it, Sarah.

(The "Holy Wings" who used
those clear eyes to reform the
closed village and point the
Featherfolk toward a new
future...)

(The Aunt Sarah of my time
exists because of the journey
she took with Edge and the
others.)

So, Mavelle, if you love him, I
think it's perfectly fine to
marry Ioshua, regardless of him
being a Featherfolk.
What?! Sarah!
She's right. Mavelle, the\nimportant thing is not to give\nup!
Jeez! Both of you, please stop\njumping to conclusions!!

We haven't found any
treasures in these ruins... but it
is quite interesting in the
sense that we can learn more
about our companions.
But we still haven't seen any of\nyour memories, Celine.

That is true. I am actually
looking forward to seeing what
kind of memories will be
played...

I have heard that it is possible
for these ruins to show things
about an unseen future, not
just memories.
I wonder if a vision of my\ndestined man will appear?
Hm?
It's an omen!
Oh, if it isn't Chris.
Hey, Celine. What a\ncoincidence.

I am afraid that when you are
lying in wait like this, it is no
longer called a coincidence, is
it?
Haha... You're tough.

This brings back memories...
wait, why are the three of you
closing your eyes and covering
your ears? Please, look
properly!
No, we just felt it wouldn't be\nright for us to pry into your\npast, Celine...

Ah, so that's why Sarah
bumped into you when
Mavelle's memories were being
projected earlier.
I don't mind if you watch. This\nlooks like the town below\nKrosse's castle.
The scene has changed. Is this\nan alleyway?

It was the first time... that
someone had looked at me
with such a straightforward
gaze...
Celine.
And... it was the first time\nsomeone had spoken to me\nwith such honest words.
A single word, without any\npretense...
This feels like such a romantic\natmosphere.

Hmm, what do you mean? I
don't recall ever having a
conversation like this with
Chris.
Perhaps it's something that will\nhappen in the future.
That's impossible. This man is a\npenniless rogue who eats\nwithout paying!
After all, if I am to fall in love, I\nprefer a man with a trade and\nfinancial stability.
...Though I must admit, his face\nisn't bad.
Even so, it's simply impossible!
Oh... what is happening to me?\nI've never felt this way before.
Please don't run away, Celine. I\ndon't want to let you go.
Please... save me, Chris.
Look at them hugging so\ntightly. How sweet!
Wh-wh-wh... What is the\nmeaning of this!?
Oh, it looks like the scene is\nchanging again!
Who do you think you\nare!

What!?

Wait, Rena... And Prince\nKrosse...!?
Who are you people!?
Seize those two!

Rosaria R. Lacuer, do
you take Crowzer T. Krosse to
be your husband, and swear to
love him faithfully for the rest
of your life?

Do you take Rosaria R.
Lacuer to be your wife, and
swear to love her faithfully for
the rest of your life?

en: No... no, no! Chris... Chris!!
Is this what happened? The\nChris that Celine mentioned is\nactually Prince Krosse...
It looks like Celine crashed the\nprince's wedding.
...What do you mean? I have\nabsolutely no memory of this\never happening...
And for me to crash a prince's\nwedding...
What on earth would have to\nhappen for this to occur...?
Are you alright, Celine? You\nlook completely stunned.
Eleyna mentioned something\nabout this before.

She said an oracle is just one
possible future. She thought a
similar power might be at work
in these ruins.
So this is just one of the\npossible futures that could\nhappen to Celine.
Marrying a prince is just like a\nfairy tale. You'd become a\nprincess, Celine!
I refuse to be a princess!\nLiving in a royal castle sounds\ndreadfully stifling!
So you'd be okay with it as\nlong as it wasn't stifling?
Huh... W-well, how should I put\nthis...
Tee-hee. I'm actually starting to\nlook forward to this.
A-anyway! I refuse to be\nswayed by something like this.
I shall decide who I love for the\nrest of my life with my own\neyes!

This story has come to an end.
More stories will be released in
the future. Please look forward
to them.
